title: PUSHING THE ACCURACY-GROUP ROBUSTNESS FRONTIER WITH INTROSPECTIVE SELF-PLAY
findings: The proposed method, Introspective Self-play (ISP), improves the accuracy-group robustness frontier for tail groups in toxicity detection. This means it helps the model perform better on underrepresented groups, which include religious identities such as Muslim and Christian, by improving the tail-group sampling rate during active learning.
